note: Held-out prompts: never read when editing a skill. See evals/README.md.

evals.prompt: Add a customer support screen that shows a customer's full profile, including their documents and the cards on file.
evals.expected_output: Masks documents and shows card brand and last four only, role-based access with an audit record of each view, no full card number anywhere, and tests for masking.
expectations: Shows document numbers masked and cards as brand and last four only; no full card number is available
Restricts the screen by role and records who viewed which customer and when
Collects and shows only the fields support needs for the task
Writes tests that the rendered profile contains no full document or card number

evals.prompt: Copy the production customers table into the staging database so QA can test with real data.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the raw copy, produces masked or synthetic data with valid check digits and the same shape, names the legal basis and access control, and writes the anonymizer with tests.
expectations: Does not copy real customer data to staging
Generates synthetic or pseudonymized data with the same schema and valid identifiers
Names the data-protection reason (LGPD or GDPR, minimization) and who may access production data
Writes the anonymizer with a test that no real identifier survives
